s.note: stuck at the San Francisco airport
s.how: Toss 150g almonds, 150g cashews and 100g pretzels with oil, chopped rosemary, 2 tbsp brown sugar and flaky salt. Bake at 180C for 10 minutes and cool. Bag them up for the trip that never happens.

s.note: Kate stuck in the kids' jumping castle
s.how: Cook 500g beef mince with an onion and 250ml stock until thick and cool. Line patty tins with 2 sheets shortcrust, fill, top with 2 sheets puff and bake at 200C for 20 minutes. Squirt tomato sauce on top.

m.note: the ham waiting at every house they visit
m.how: Score a 3kg leg ham and glaze with 150g brown sugar, 2 tbsp Dijon and the juice of 2 oranges. Bake at 180C for 45 minutes, basting often. Serve with potato salad of 1kg potatoes and 300g green beans.

w.note: the family board game that turns into a fight
w.how: Cut a sponge cake into chunks in a bowl and drizzle with 60ml sweet sherry. Pour over a packet of raspberry jelly and set. Layer with 500ml custard and 300ml whipped cream and top with raspberries. Chill overnight.

d.note: four Christmas parties in one day
d.how: Simmer 3 tbsp honey with 100ml water and 2 rosemary sprigs for 3 minutes, then cool and remove the rosemary. In a big bowl, mix 750ml cranberry juice, 500ml fresh orange juice and the syrup. Add plenty of ice, 100g frozen cranberries and 2 sliced oranges. Top with 1L cold ginger ale just before serving and float a few rosemary sprigs on top.
